steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: force-loss-then-restore
steps.eval: (() => { const ext = window.__three.gl.getContext().getExtension('WEBGL_lose_context'); ext.loseContext(); setTimeout(() => ext.restoreContext(), 800); window.__envAfter = null; setTimeout(() => { window.__envAfter = !!window.__three.scene.environment }, 6000); })()

steps.name: assert-env-rebuilt
steps.failMessage: scene.environment not rebuilt after context restore (GPU-STARVE-2 regression)
